airmode.beginner: ADVANCED - Keeps full stick authority even at zero throttle. Essential for freestyle tricks and flips. Usually kept on all the time.

angle.beginner: BEGINNER MODE - Your aircraft will automatically level itself when you release the sticks. Maximum tilt angle is limited. Perfect for learning to fly!

arm.beginner: SAFETY SWITCH - Arms/disarms your aircraft. ALWAYS put this on a dedicated switch! When armed, propellers can spin at any moment.

beeper.beginner: FINDER - Makes your aircraft beep loudly to help you find it after a crash. Very useful when it lands in tall grass!

blackbox.beginner: LOGGING - Records flight data to the SD card for analysis. Useful for tuning PIDs and reviewing crashes.

failsafe.beginner: EMERGENCY - Triggers failsafe behavior (usually landing or disarm). Normally activated automatically when signal is lost.

flaperon.beginner: Activates flaperons for slower landing approach. Ailerons droop down to act as flaps.

gcsNav.beginner: Allow ground control station to send navigation commands (fly-to-here, etc).

gimbalLevelTilt.beginner: Keeps gimbal tilt axis level regardless of aircraft attitude. Useful for camera stabilization.

headingHold.beginner: Maintains current magnetic heading. Useful for flying straight lines.

homeReset.beginner: Sets current position as new home point. Use when you relocate during a session.

horizon.beginner: INTERMEDIATE MODE - Self-levels near center stick like ANGLE, but allows flips and rolls at full stick. A bridge between ANGLE and ACRO.

manual.beginner: Direct servo/motor control without stabilization. For experienced pilots only!

navAlthold.beginner: Holds current altitude using barometer/GPS. Throttle controls climb/descent rate.

navCourseHold.beginner: Maintains current heading while allowing altitude control. Good for flying in a straight line.

navCruise.beginner: Fixed-wing cruise mode - Maintains heading and altitude. Perfect for long-range flights.

navLaunch.beginner: Automatic launch sequence for fixed-wing. Throw the plane and it will climb to safe altitude.

navPoshold.beginner: GPS position hold - Aircraft will stay in place. Great for aerial photography or when you need to stop.

navRth.beginner: Return To Home - Aircraft will climb to safe altitude and fly back to launch point. Essential safety feature!

navWp.beginner: Execute uploaded waypoint mission. Aircraft will fly to each waypoint automatically.

prearm.beginner: Safety switch - must be enabled before arming. Prevents accidental arm.

turnAssist.beginner: Auto-coordinates rudder with ailerons for smooth turns. Great for fixed-wing beginners.

turtle.beginner: Flip crashed aircraft back over using motor spin. For multirotors only.

wpPlanner.beginner: Enable in-flight waypoint planning via stick commands.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.tip: Your aircraft will always stay level. Perfect for learning to hover and basic movements!

cinematic.name: Cinematic
cinematic.tip: NAV RTH brings your aircraft home if signal is lost (requires GPS!). Perfect for long-range filming.

fixedWing.name: Fixed Wing
fixedWing.tip: Complete setup for fixed-wing with launch assist, RTH, and waypoint navigation.

freestyle.name: Freestyle
freestyle.tip: Three-position switch on AUX2 gives you ANGLE/HORIZON/ACRO. Flip a switch to change your flying style!

racing.name: Racing
racing.tip: Pure ACRO mode for maximum control. Beeper on AUX3 helps find your aircraft after a crash!
